messages:
Amanda L: Quick ask — webinar goes live next Tue (10am PT). Need: 3 X posts (pre, day-of, follow), 2 LinkedIn posts, and a 6-tweet X thread teasing the benchmark highlights. Who can own copy + final asset polish?

Raj P: I can take copy. What's the CTA and target? Product demo signup or general webinar RSVP? Also want to A/B subject for the day-of post.

Amanda L: CTA = webinar RSVP (Cal link). Target = PLG/self-serve engineers + platform leads. A/B idea: value-first vs numbers-first.

Jen M: For assets: will we reuse last week's benchmark chart? If so I can crop and annotate. Need sizes: X hero 1200x675, LinkedIn 1200x627. Also need 1 smaller square for socials. Can someone confirm license for the chart?

Drew G: I can do visuals. Need final copy by Friday EOD to hit production. Can do a quick GIF of the chart highlight for X. GIF + static hero + linkedin card, ok?

Amanda L: GIF sounds great. Timeline: copy to Drew by Fri EOD, assets finalized Mon morning, schedule Tue 9am for day-of post. Also we should plan engagement cadence: replies at +10m, +1h, +4h from the comms lead.

Raj P: Draft X thread below — please skim and edit. Trying short punchy sentences.

```
1/ New: Our webinar shows how to cut LLM inference cost by 3x without model tradeoffs. Join us Tue ▶️ [cal.link]
2/ We benchmarked 5 open models at scale and measured latency & cost under real traffic.
3/ Key win: prefix caching + batching reduced token spend by ~40% in our tests.
4/ We'll demo rollout patterns to avoid warm-up latency on spikes.
5/ Q&A at the end — bring infra & product questions.
6/ Register: [cal.link] #LLM #inference #redwood
```

Raj P: Thoughts? Tone okay for X or too demo-heavy?

Jen M: Content's good. For LinkedIn we should soften jargon — swap "token spend" for "inference cost" and add a short customer example. Also add UTM params: ?utm_source=x&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=webinar_apr

Amanda L: Good call on UTMs. Routing: any inbound signups -> Intercom lead inbox; MQL (company size >50 + engaged) -> sales queue. Can we standardize tags? tag:webinar_apr, source:social, channel:x|linkedin

Drew G: For the hero header: I'll export 1200x675 (X), 1200x627 (LinkedIn), and 600x600 (square). If we need a cropped version for the thread lead card I can supply 800x418. Need the final line of copy for the hero ASAP.

Raj P: Final tweaks to thread: swap line 3 to "prefix caching + batching cut token spend ~40%" -> Jen's suggestion to say "inference cost". Here's updated snippet: `prefix caching + batching cut inference cost by ~40%`

Amanda L: Perfect. SocialBot — once assets + copy are approved, schedule: pre-post Tue 8am PT, day-of 9:50am PT, follow 12:30pm PT. Also auto-enable replies from comms for first 4 hours.

SocialBot: @Amanda L — Scheduling template received. To confirm, run: `/schedule channel=marketing time=2109950400 assets=webinar_apr_v1 copy_version=raj_v3 tags=webinar_apr,source:social` — react with :white_check_mark: to queue.

Jen M: I'll verify licence for the benchmark chart and add the LinkedIn-friendly sentence. ETA Thu noon.

Drew G: :thumbsup: I'll mock up GIF and hero by Mon AM.

Amanda L: Thanks all — locking final copy deadline: Fri 5pm PT. Raj, ping here when copy v3 is ready so Jen and Drew can iterate.

Raj P: Will do. Planning to drop v3 by Friday 3pm.

SocialBot: Noted. Reminder set for Amanda L and Drew G at 2021-11-05T17:00:00Z."
